requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Concern-mixing detected per Pohl §25.2. Requirement decomposed into one functional requirement (inform security service) and one quality requirement (response time constraint). Ambiguities regarding 'pane' and temporal scope resolved via controlled context glossary and constraints.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Response time constraint moved to separate quality requirement. Ambiguity AMB-01 resolved: 'pane' refers to the glass itself.

fields.condition: after the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds after the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2. Ambiguity AMB-02 resolved: total time from detection to notification must not exceed 2 seconds.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific communication protocols or hardware implementation details.
